paper.title: MM-Zero: Self-Evolving Multi-Model Vision Language Models From Zero Data
paper.central_claim: Proposer–Coder–Solver 三角色从零外部训练数据交替GRPO训练，使VLM视觉推理能力提高。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: pinned text read before opening seat records (abstract, method, experiments, every table and appendix present in the pinned text) ; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.quote: All three roles are initialized from the same base model and trained using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
evidence.support_explanation: 改进对象为三角色模型权重。

evidence.quote: Each model is optimized sequentially via GRPO, with role-specific reward functions that form a closed training loop.
evidence.support_explanation: 交替训练，不是修改持久非权重harness。

evidence.quote: We retain only successfully rendered images and their associated questions as the training set for the solver.
evidence.support_explanation: 保留数据用于训练；未成为后续任务读取的技能/工具库。

evidence.quote: All three models use full fine-tuning (LoRA rank 0); the vision tower is trainable.
evidence.support_explanation: 全文附录明确被更新和留存对象是参数。

evidence.quote: Since ground truth labels are unavailable for these generated questions, we use Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (TTRL) via majority voting.
evidence.support_explanation: 自监督多数票信号用于模型训练。

evidence.quote: We train the ablated model using identical hyperparameters for three iterations.
evidence.support_explanation: 消融也评价训练后的模型，不评价代码工具的留存。

evidence.quote: Each model is optimized sequentially via GRPO, with role-specific reward functions that form a closed training loop.
evidence.support_explanation: The improver operation is RL weight updates of each role.

evidence.quote: All three models use full fine-tuning (LoRA rank 0); the vision tower is trainable.
evidence.support_explanation: The updated and evaluated object is model weights (full fine-tuning), not a non-weight harness component.

evidence.quote: self-evolving reinforcement learning framework that trains VLMs without relying on any external data
evidence.support_explanation: Author's central claim is a weight-training framework.

evidence.quote: Since ground truth labels are unavailable for these generated questions, we use Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (TTRL) via majority voting.
evidence.support_explanation: Solver reward is a majority-vote pseudo-label; operation is manufactured supervision for weight updates.

evidence.quote: for the base model, an improvement of 4 percentage points without any data.
evidence.support_explanation: Reported outcome is a benchmark average of the trained weights.

evidence.quote: we retain only examples where the rendering success rate across 4 rollouts falls between 0.25 and 0.75
evidence.support_explanation: Generated data are filtered per round and used once for training; no persistent non-weight store.

evidence.quote: We use a rollout size of 4 for the coder and 5 for the solver to reduce reward computation cost.
evidence.support_explanation: Cost-related setting only; total search/training cost beyond GPU count is not reported.

evidence.quote: All three roles are initialized from the same base model and trained using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
evidence.support_explanation: All three roles improve through GRPO weight updates.

evidence.quote: All three models use full fine-tuning (LoRA rank 0); the vision tower is trainable.
evidence.support_explanation: The persisted change is full model weights.

evidence.quote: We retain only successfully rendered images and their associated questions as the training set for the solver.
evidence.support_explanation: The 'retained' artifacts are RL training data, not a harness component.
